# Calibration — math appendix

<!-- GENERATED by video_studio/scripts/docs.mjs (same code as the video: video_studio/src/lib/regression.js) -->

**Illustrative data — not a patient result, not a real method.** Generic photometric example: absorbance A (dimensionless) against concentration c in arbitrary units (a.u.). Values are invented for teaching; they are defined once in `storyboard.json → data` and every number on screen is computed from them in code.

## 2. Ordinary least squares (y = b₀ + b₁·x)

| Quantity | Formula | Value |
|---|---|---|
| n | | 5 |
| x̄ | Σx / n | 5.000000 |
| ȳ | Σy / n | 0.409200 |
| Sxx | Σ(x − x̄)² | 62.500000 |
| Sxy | Σ(x − x̄)(y − ȳ) | 4.972500 |
| Syy = SS_tot | Σ(y − ȳ)² | 0.39565080 |
| slope b₁ | Sxy / Sxx | 0.07956000 |
| intercept b₀ | ȳ − b₁·x̄ | 0.01140000 |
| SS_res | Σ(y − ŷ)² | 0.0000387000 |
| R² | 1 − SS_res / SS_tot | 0.99990219 |
| s(y\|x) | √(SS_res / (n − 2)) | 0.003592 |

Shown on screen (rounded): slope 0.0796, intercept 0.0114, R² 0.9999; residual signs + + - - + (max |residual| 0.0042).

## 3. Controls read off the curve (inverse prediction ĉ = (A − b₀) / b₁)

| Control | Target c (a.u.) | A measured | ĉ (a.u.) | ĉ / target |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| QC-L | 3.0 | 0.252 | 3.0241 | 100.80 % |
| QC-H | 6.0 | 0.486 | 5.9653 | 99.42 % |

The hook number (0.486) is control QC-H; the video answers it as 5.97 a.u. **No acceptance limit is stated or implied**: the video says limits come from the IFU and the laboratory SOP. "% of target" is arithmetic, not a pass/fail verdict.

## 4. What the numbers do NOT mean

- R² close to 1 does not prove linearity or accuracy; residuals are shown for that reason (textbook statistics, see epistemic table).
- Number of calibrators, blank handling and the curve model (linear, spline, 4PL…) are method-specific and come from the reagent IFU (app text `calGuide2`).
- LabGuide itself does not compute calibration curves: it records the lot, the assigned values the user copies from the value sheet, the outcome, QC after calibration and the approver.
